issues: Document consists of 104 scanned pages: pages 1-103 are the table of accreditation scope (Приложение), page 104 is a signature/certification page with no table rows. All pages were printed rotated 90 degrees relative to the portrait page and were re-rendered upright (rotation +270) before reading; no other rotation issues were found. The source table's own row numbering (column 1, п/п) is not fully sequential/unique in the original document (e.g. it repeats '394' twice, skips several numbers such as 255, 391, 393) - this is a printing artifact of the source and does not affect the extracted content, since п/п numbers are not part of the output schema. Very long OKPD2/TNVED code lists spanning multiple page-break rows were reassembled from context; a few individual code fragments in those very long lists may be imprecise due to line-wrap ambiguity, but no numeric ranges or indicator names were invented. A handful of rows have compound/multi-value ranges (e.g. rows for ГОСТ 32219, МУ 5-1-14/1005, ГОСТ 33615, ФР.1.31.2012.12703, СП СССР №4695) that combine several methods/tiers in one printed range cell; these were split into separate rows or kept as combined text where the mapping to a single indicator was unambiguous - see the 'note' markers embedded in a few raw_row_text values.
